name: What is included in a typical room painting service?
description: A typical room painting service includes surface preparation, priming, two coats of paint, protection of your belongings, and cleanup.

mainEntity.name: What is included in a typical room painting service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our standard room painting service includes surface preparation such as patching small holes and cracks, sanding, and cleaning. We apply one coat of primer and two coats of high-quality paint. We also cover and protect your furniture and flooring, and perform a thorough cleanup after the project is complete. More extensive repairs, specialty paints, or additional coats may be extra.
